label: Its definition
note: NAND = AND followed by NOT, so the output is the AND result inverted

label: Block diagram
note: Inputs A and B enter a NAND block; the output is the complement of AB

label: Truth table
note: Columns A, B, AB and complement of AB. AB is 0, 0, 0, 1 for the four input combinations, so the NAND output is 1, 1, 1, 0

label: Standard NAND symbol
note: The curved gate body with a bubble on the output; the bubble is what marks the inversion
